newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Volatile Russian MinFins edge down, no trend seen.
newsitem.headline: Volatile Russian MinFins edge down, no trend seen.

text.p: Russian MinFin bonds eased in lively speculative trading on Thursday but dealers said no clear trend was seen on a volatile market in the absence of fresh

"Major dealers seem to be fighting trying to move the market. It does not know where to go as bid/offer volumes are high while spreads are narrow," National Reserve Bank dealer Andrei Ivanov-Golitsyn said.
Dealers said prices had fallen in early trading but gained later at attractive levels and on short-covering.
They forecast prices could remain steady, with the market awaiting a strong push in either way.
A Mosbiznesbank dealer said prices of the most liquid fourth and fifth tranches were unlikely to break through resistance at 64.00 and 45.00 respectively, given no fresh market-moving factors.
"The market is calm before a storm. A strong buyer or seller is needed to move it from the dead point," Ivanov-Golitsyn said.
